schema_note: Each entry follows docs/mvp/templates/skill-authoring/trigger-queries.json (id, query, should_trigger, split) plus category and, for explicit invocation, installation_mode. Tier A only: these observe whether a fresh session consults the skill for a request that does not name it. No entry supplies the skill path or name except the explicit_invocation category, which is recorded separately and is never counted as implicit activation evidence.
installation_note: Project-local installation under .claude/skills/ is the stated default for scaffold evaluation, invoked as /devforge-evaluate-expert. The exported plugin is the recorded alternative, invoked as /devforgeai:devforge-evaluate-expert. The two are different installation modes; a result in one does not prove the other, and both must not be installed at once during a discovery run.
split_policy: Fixed and stratified by should_trigger and category, assigned once at authoring time and recorded here. It is not re-randomised per run. Validation entries and their should_trigger values must not be placed in an author-loop or task-worker context; only the train split may drive any description iteration.
